name: quicks3
description: Browse, transfer, and share files through the quickS3 MCP server

interface.shortDescription: Safely browse, transfer, and share object-storage files.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to quickS3 to list permitted storage connections, buckets, folders, and objects, to create controlled upload and download transfers, and to create expiring share links using delegated quickS3 roles.
defaultPrompt: List the folders I can access in quickS3.
Show me the files in a quickS3 folder.
Upload a file to quickS3 without overwriting anything.
Create a quickS3 share link for a file that lasts 7 days.
